description: Engine setup of map1_s01 (School - 2F), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type SC, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: LarvalStalker, Stalker, GreyChild, Mumbler and Cat). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: smoke_column (a rising smoke column; parameters in the map variables smoke_emitter.*). Here smoke_column is the smoke in the locker room. A mod changes it with its own maps/map1_s01/overlay.json.
